description: Na<sub>2</sub>CO<sub>3.</sub>H<sub>2</sub>O crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pca2<sub>1</sub> space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.52 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to one H and six O atoms. The Na-H bond length is 2.50 Å. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.73 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.29 Å) and one longer (1.30 Å) C-O bond length. There are two inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Na and one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.00 Å) and one longer (1.64 Å) H-O bond length. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two Na and two H atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to three Na and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to four Na and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to three Na, one C, and one H atom.
